_about: Episode 1 shot list. Each shot = a keyframe still (composed from approved plates and character sheets, or an approved image used directly) + a motion prompt for image-to-video. Paths are relative to the project root. model: 'video' = MODEL_VIDEO, 'hero' = MODEL_VIDEO_HERO. Reaction loops are generated from the 'react' block. Also holds the Episode 2 shots and stills ("still": true shots are images only).
camera: Hand-held camera with gentle operator sway and micro-shake, as if filmed by someone standing in the room.
keep: Keep every face, hair, costume and the set exactly as in the reference image. Photoreal, film grain, no text, no morphing, no extra people.

keyframe.prompt: Medium shot from slightly below the throne: Aurie, the woman from the identity photographs, sits upright on the black glass throne, her face large and clearly lit in the upper third of the frame, utterly still and regal, her long black hair lifting in its own slow wind. At the frame edges: the pale-suited man kneeling with head bowed (back of his head only), Lucienne at her shoulder with lantern and ledger. Starfield walls behind, one candle on the throne arm lighting her face warmly. FRAMING RULE (overrides everything above about composition): this is a CLOSE-UP. Aurie's head and shoulders fill the frame; her face is at least one third of the frame height, sharp and fully visible, eyes to camera or near it. The location reference image is ONLY for the background colours and textures behind her, softly out of focus; never reproduce its wide composition. Other people appear only as soft shapes at the frame edges, never as faces.

shots.motion: Aurie listens without moving; only her hair drifts upward and a thin stream of sand rises from the base of the throne. Lucienne turns a page of her ledger. The kneeling man does not lift his head. Very slow push-in toward Aurie's face.

keyframe.prompt: First-person view from the throne: a pale, long-fingered woman's hand in a black sleeve raised in the foreground, palm out. Ahead on the black glass floor a hunched shadowy nightmare creature, all teeth and smoke, is mid-lunge toward the throne. Starfield walls, cool silver light.

shots.motion: The raised hand closes slowly into a fist; the nightmare creature freezes mid-lunge and dissolves from the edges inward into drifting grey sand that pours across the black glass floor. Static first-person framing.

keyframe.prompt: Medium shot, waist up, slightly low angle: Aurie stands before the throne mid-sentence, her face large in frame, as chalk-white lines of a magic circle flare up through the black glass floor around her, lighting her face from below like burning magnesium. Expression: sudden alarm breaking through regal calm. Starfield behind her. FRAMING RULE (overrides everything above about composition): this is a CLOSE-UP. Aurie's head and shoulders fill the frame; her face is at least one third of the frame height, sharp and fully visible, eyes to camera or near it. The location reference image is ONLY for the background colours and textures behind her, softly out of focus; never reproduce its wide composition. Other people appear only as soft shapes at the frame edges, never as faces.

shots.motion: The chalk lines blaze brighter and the circle tightens; Aurie looks down at her feet, then is pulled straight downward through the glass floor in one violent motion, her hair streaming upward. The lines flare white and the frame burns out to black.

keyframe.prompt: Tight close-up of Aurie, the woman in the reference images, at the moment she wakes: her long black hair tangled around her face, eyes heavy and just opening, looking straight into the camera, lips parted as she draws a first breath. Warm candlelight on one cheek, cold blue light from above, a dark stone cellar behind her with soft candle bokeh. No glass anywhere in front of her face. FRAMING RULE: a true close-up, her face at least half the frame height, sharp, evenly lit and fully visible, looking toward the camera; nothing between the lens and her face. Background dark and softly out of focus.

shots.motion: Locked-off static close-up, the camera does not move and does not zoom. She only lifts her heavy eyelids slowly and breathes; her head stays still and her face does not change. Far behind her, out of focus, a dark figure passes carrying something. Candle flames flicker.

keyframe.prompt: First-person view from inside the glass sphere, as in the plate: through the curved scratched glass, Roderick Burgess from the character sheet crouches close outside, his face slightly warped by the glass, lit from below by candlelight, the burgundy robe pooled on the flagstones.

shots.motion: Burgess leans closer, his face swelling in the curve of the glass, lips moving as he speaks; he taps the glass twice with his signet ring and his breath briefly fogs it. Static first-person framing with slight breathing sway.

keyframe.prompt: Tight close-up of Aurie, the woman in the reference images, sitting utterly still inside the sphere, eyes level and unblinking, looking straight into the camera with cold, silent contempt. Warm candlelight on one cheek, cold blue light from above, a dark cellar behind her with soft candle bokeh. FRAMING RULE: a true close-up, her face at least half the frame height, sharp, evenly lit and fully visible, looking toward the camera; nothing between the lens and her face; no glass over her features. Background dark and softly out of focus.

shots.motion: A long silent stare: she does not blink or move; only a strand of her hair stirs and the candle light flickers across her face. Static framing, faint hand-held sway.

keyframe.prompt: Medium close shot: inside the glass sphere Aurie has risen to her knees, close to the glass, her face large and sharp in frame, set in cold fury, her breath fogging the glass in front of her. At the right edge of the frame, Burgess recoils a step back, one arm half raised, partly cut off by the frame. FRAMING RULE (overrides everything above about composition): this is a CLOSE-UP. Aurie's head and shoulders fill the frame; her face is at least one third of the frame height, sharp and fully visible, eyes to camera or near it. The location reference image is ONLY for the background colours and textures behind her, softly out of focus; never reproduce its wide composition. Other people appear only as soft shapes at the frame edges, never as faces.

shots.motion: Burgess stumbles back another step, catching himself on the lectern; the candles nearest the sphere gutter and lean away from it. Aurie remains kneeling, staring. Quick small hand-held reaction.

keyframe.prompt: The 1916 cellar: Roderick Burgess beside the glass sphere, head thrown back in contemptuous laughter, one hand on his chest, candlelight on his teeth.

shots.motion: Burgess laughs, then stops abruptly and leans close to the glass, the smile gone, wagging one finger slowly. Slow push-in on his face.

keyframe.prompt: A British soldier of 1916 lies on his back in a muddy trench at night, rain falling, eyes wide open and unblinking, staring at the sky as flares burst overhead. Exhausted, filthy, alive. Photoreal war photography.

shots.motion: Flares drift down and light his face white then red; shells thud in the distance; men around him sleep; his eyes stay open and never close. Slow downward crane toward his face.

keyframe.prompt: A girl of about ten, Edwardian, asleep in a white iron bed in a sunlit English bedroom of 1916, dark hair spread on the pillow, a calendar on the wall beside her. Peaceful, but too still.

shots.motion: Time-lapse: sunlight sweeps across the room again and again; calendar pages peel away and fall; the girl in the bed ages slowly into a grey-haired woman, still asleep, never waking. Static camera.

The palace towers dissolve from the top down into streams of grey sand that pour sideways on a soundless wind and vanish; a whole stairway crumbles away into the mist. The intact reflection below does not change. Slow aerial drift.

keyframe.prompt: First-person view from inside the glass sphere in the dusty 1970s cellar lit by a bare bulb: outside the curved glass, Alex Burgess from the character sheet (here about sixty, hair greying, the same black rectangular spectacles, standing, no wheelchair) leans close to the glass, frightened and tender. Behind him in the doorway stands Paul McGuire from his sheet, watching.

shots.motion: Alex lifts one hand and hesitates before laying his palm flat on the glass, his lips forming a question; Paul shifts his weight in the doorway. The bulb flickers once. Static first-person framing.

keyframe.prompt: A dim 1970s English bedroom at night. Alex Burgess from the character sheet (about sixty, his own face, grey at the temples, his black rectangular glasses on the bedside table) sits bolt upright in bed, just woken, tears on his face, one hand over his mouth.

shots.motion: Alex's shoulders shake as he cries silently; he reaches for his spectacles, puts them on, and looks toward the door as if he might go down to the cellar. Slow push-in.

keyframe.prompt: First-person view from inside the glass sphere in the 1970s cellar: Alex Burgess (about sixty, his own face, grey at the temples, black rectangular glasses) stands outside the glass, waiting, hands clasped, hope fading from his face.

shots.motion: Nothing comes from the sphere. Alex's face falls; he lowers his eyes, turns and walks slowly to the door, looking back once before he goes. Static first-person framing.

keyframe.prompt: A dream image: Alex Burgess (about sixty, his own face, grey at the temples, black rectangular glasses) stands in the grey-blue dawn cellar staring in horror at his own much older self, white-haired and slumped in a wheelchair under a tartan blanket, beside an empty cracked glass sphere.

shots.motion: The old self in the wheelchair slowly raises its head and looks straight at the younger Alex; Alex stumbles backward and screams soundlessly; the dawn light snaps to black.

keyframe.prompt: First-person view from inside the glass sphere at night, 1988: the sleeping security guard from the character sheet has slid down and sits with his back and head resting against the outside of the curved glass, mouth open, breath fogging a small oval on the glass.

shots.motion: The guard breathes slowly in deep sleep; the fogged oval on the glass widens with each breath, and inside the fog, faintly, a warm amber room begins to appear. Static first-person framing.

keyframe.prompt: Tight close-up at night in the 1988 cellar: Aurie's face and shoulders are already through the glass, emerging toward the camera out of a curtain of fog, nothing between the lens and her face; the warm amber glow of the pub inside the fog lights one side of her face, the cold blue of the cellar the other; her long black hair lifts in a wind that touches nothing else; her eyes are open and calm. At the very bottom edge of the frame, out of focus, the top of the sleeping guard's head against the glass. FRAMING RULE: close-up, her head at least half the frame height, face sharp and fully visible, no distortion of her features by glass. The location reference is only for background colours, softly out of focus. Other people only as soft shapes at the edges.

shots.motion: Aurie steps out through the fogged glass as if through water, rising to her full height beside the sleeping guard, her long black hair lifting in a wind that touches nothing else; behind her the chalk circle crumbles into drifting dust. Slow push-in from a low angle.

keyframe.prompt: Recreate the attached scene exactly (the ruined cellar at dawn, the wheelchair, the scream, the shaft of light, the shattered sphere), but the old man's face must be the man in the identity photographs aged to seventy-two.

shots.motion: Alex is wheeled through the doorway, half turning in the wheelchair, his hand flung up to ward something off, mouth open in a scream; the tartan blanket slides from his knees; dust turns in the dawn shaft.

keyframe.prompt: Alex Burgess, white-haired, the black rectangular spectacles taped at one hinge, jolting awake in a hospital bed in a bare grey room at night, gasping, clutching the sheets.

shots.motion: Alex wakes, gasps, looks around; the room behind him subtly changes, the walls a little closer, the light a little colder; he wakes again, and again, each time into a worse version of the same room. Static camera, hand-held sway.

keyframe.prompt: Alex Burgess, white-haired, spectacles on the bedside table, asleep in an armchair by a window at night, twisting in a nightmare under a tartan blanket.

shots.motion: He twists and mutters through the night, then grey morning light fills the window and his face slowly goes slack and peaceful; he sleeps on, the nightmare gone. Static camera.

keyframe.prompt: The 1988 cellar at dawn, seen from behind Aurie, the woman from the character sheet, in her long black gown, as she walks away toward the open cellar door and the grey-blue morning beyond; the cracked empty sphere behind her; her bare footprints in the dust.

shots.motion: Aurie walks slowly out through the door without looking back, the gown swinging, her footprints appearing in the dust behind her; the dawn light grows as she passes into it. Camera stays, slight sway.

keyframe.prompt: Wide photograph at the ruined gates of horn and ivory from the plate: Aurie, the woman from the character sheet, stands before the split horn gate seen from behind and to the side, looking at the ruin. Beyond the threshold, small in the mist, Lucienne from her character sheet waits with her lantern raised.

shots.motion: Aurie walks slowly between the broken gates, sand drifting around her bare feet; Lucienne lowers her lantern and comes forward a step to meet her. Slow follow from behind.

A slow first-person walk down the long reading table toward the wall of doors; the lantern flame on the table leans as fog seeps under the Neverwhere door and sand trickles from under The Alchemist's door; dust turns in the light. Smooth forward dolly with slight sway.

Lucienne turns toward the camera with the lantern raised, relief breaking through her composure, and her lips form the words 'My lady'; the book on the shelf writes another line by itself. Slow push-in.

keyframe.prompt: Wide shot of the 1916 candle-lit cellar from the location plate, the night of the ritual. Roderick Burgess, the man from the character sheet, in his burgundy ceremonial robe, stands at the wooden lectern reading aloud from a huge open grimoire, one hand raised. Around the chalk circle stand seven hooded figures in dark brown robes, faces hidden in shadow, each holding a candle. In the centre the great glass sphere on its iron stand is empty, but a faint pale mist has begun to swirl inside it, and the chalk lines glow faintly white.

shots.motion: The hooded figures sway as they chant; every candle flame leans toward the sphere; the chalk circle blazes white; inside the glass the mist thickens and condenses into the pale shape of a woman curled on the glass floor, long black hair spreading. Burgess lowers his hand and stares. Slow push-in toward the sphere.

keyframe.prompt: The same girl as in the reference image, about ten years old, Edwardian, dark hair, now inside her own dream: she stands barefoot in a long white nightdress on a sunlit clifftop meadow above a bright blue sea, gulls overhead, wildflowers around her ankles. Behind her, at the meadow's edge, grows a tall hedge of deep red roses, and half hidden among the roses, out of focus, an elegant figure in a pale suit watches, face not visible. She looks toward the camera as if someone invisible has just spoken to her. Warm golden light, a soft dreamy glow at the edges of the frame.

shots.motion: The girl tilts her head, listening to someone unseen, then smiles shyly toward the camera; the wind moves her nightdress and the grass; gulls wheel overhead; among the roses the half-hidden figure steps back and is gone, leaving the roses trembling. Gentle hand-held drift toward the girl.

keyframe.prompt: Night, 1926: the narrow stone stairway leading up out of the cellar from the location plate. A young woman of about twenty-five, Ethel Cripps, slim and sharp-faced, red lipstick, a black cloche hat and a camel coat with a fur collar, hurries up the stairs looking back over her shoulder, frightened and exhilarated. She clutches an open leather Gladstone bag to her chest; from its mouth show a red ruby the size of an egg, the curve of a dark helm shaped like an old gas mask with a long ridged breathing tube, and a small leather pouch leaking golden sand. Below and behind her the candle-lit cellar, the glass sphere glowing faintly. A single candle in her other hand lights her face from below.

1947, the cellar from the location plate, cold and dim, most candles burned down to stubs. Roderick Burgess, the man from the character sheet, now very old, thin and white-bearded, a tartan blanket over his knees, sits dead in a high-backed leather armchair facing the great glass sphere, eyes open, one hand still lifted toward it. A newspaper has slid from his lap to the stone floor. Inside the sphere a dark motionless shape of a woman sits with her back to him.

Wide shot at night of the crossroads from the location plate, seen from the road as someone approaches, so no one else is in frame. At the centre, beside the standing stones, the three women from the character sheet stand together: the red-haired maiden with her spindle, the mother in red with the thread taut between her hands, the tiny crone in black with her iron shears, one unbroken thread running through all three. Mist at their feet, silver grass, the moon above.

shots.motion: The mist parts; the three women turn their heads toward the camera one after another, maiden, mother, crone; the thread between their hands glints and runs; the crone slowly opens her shears; the silver grass moves in rings around them. Slow push-in along the road.

keyframe.prompt: The London terraced street from the location plate, now after midnight in heavy rain, sodium streetlights, puddles. Seen from behind, two women walk side by side toward the house whose one upstairs window glows a wrong gold: on the left Johanna Constantine from her character sheet in her rain-dark trench coat; on the right a tall woman with very long black hair in a long black coat over a black gown (seen only from behind, face never visible).

shots.motion: The two women walk away from the camera toward the house through the rain; the blonde woman glances sideways at her companion; the gold window flickers; water splashes from their steps. Follow from behind.

keyframe.prompt: Close-up at night in heavy rain: Johanna Constantine, the woman from the character sheet, sheltering under a dripping porch on the London street from the location plate, cupping a match to light a cigarette, her pale eyes lifted straight to the camera, wary and tired, as if looking at someone she did not expect and is not sure she wants. Sodium light on one side of her face, the gold glow of an upstairs window on the other, rain streaks behind her.

Point of view from the doorway of the overgrown bedroom from the location plate. Rachel, the woman from the character sheet, lies on the iron bed half absorbed into the breathing growth, golden sand on her lips and eyelashes, smiling at nothing. On the bedside table the small leather pouch lies open, spilling glowing sand across the floor.

shots.motion: The growth on the walls breathes slowly; sand drifts upward from Rachel's lips; her eyes slide toward the doorway without recognition; the camera moves slowly into the room; a long pale woman's hand enters the frame from the camera and reaches toward the pouch.

keyframe.prompt: Close on Rachel, the woman from the character sheet, lying on the iron bed in the overgrown room from the location plate, her face beginning to soften into peace; a long pale woman's hand rests gently on her forehead from the edge of the frame. The small leather pouch lies open on the blanket beside her.

shots.motion: Rachel's face softens, her eyes close, she smiles; the growth on the walls withers into golden dust and the dust streams in a slow spiral into the open leather pouch until the room is bare and quiet; grey dawn light grows in the window. Very slow push-in.

keyframe.prompt: The colossal gates of Hell from the location plate, low camera on the cracked road. In the foreground, a tall woman with very long straight black hair in a long black gown, seen only from behind, her face never visible, stands small before the towering black iron doors, which have just begun to open a crack, red light spilling through. Ash falling.

shots.motion: The colossal doors grind slowly open, red light and smoke pouring out; the woman walks forward into the light without hesitating; ash swirls around her; the bodies in the cliff face turn their heads to watch her pass. Slow follow from behind.

keyframe.prompt: A narrow corridor deep in Hell, lit by dull red light. Set into the black rock wall, a column of clear black ice, and frozen inside it, alive, a young African queen of an ancient city: dark skin, high cheekbones, intricate braided hair threaded with gold, a gold collar, a white linen gown. One hand pressed flat against the inside of the ice, her eyes open and pleading, looking straight at the camera. Frost and ash on the ice. Heartbreaking, regal, never sexualised.

The arena of Hell from the location plate, the camera low on the obsidian floor looking up the black stone stair. On the high narrow throne sits Lucifer, the man from the character sheet, in his black robe, white wings folded, looking down at the camera. On two lesser thrones beside him, huge shadowy demon lords, one with the head of a great fly. The tiers of demons blurred in red darkness.

shots.motion: Lucifer rises slowly from the throne, his white scorched wings opening halfway; the demons in the tiers lean forward and fall silent; ash drifts across the red light. Slow push-in up the stair toward him.

keyframe.prompt: The obsidian floor at the centre of the arena from the location plate, the reflective floor showing blue sky. Choronzon, the demon from the character sheet, stands in the ring holding up the dark gas-mask helm in one long hand, grinning at the camera. Thousands of demons in the tiers behind him, blurred.

shots.motion: Choronzon lifts the helm high and the crowd of demons roars; then his body dissolves into black smoke that pours down and reshapes into a huge snarling wolf made of smoke and embers, which lunges toward the camera. Hand-held, the camera stumbles back.

keyframe.prompt: The arena of Hell swallowed by a vast black nothing: a wall of absolute darkness eating the tiers and the light. In the centre of the frame, held in a long pale woman's hand reaching in from the camera, a single small warm golden light. Choronzon, the demon from the character sheet, small and recoiling at the edge of the darkness, the helm in his hand.

shots.motion: The golden light in the hand grows brighter and brighter; the darkness peels back like burning paper; Choronzon shrieks and drops the helm, which rolls across the obsidian toward the camera and stops at the hand. Slow push-in.

keyframe.prompt: The exit of the arena of Hell, a great arch of black basalt, completely blocked by thousands of demons packed shoulder to shoulder, horned, winged, armoured, weapons raised. In front of them, calm and alone, Lucifer from the character sheet, wings folded, looking at the camera with a faint, cold smile. Red light and ash.

A bare padded cell in an old American asylum at night, 1988. John Dee, the man from the character sheet, in a grey institutional gown, sits on a narrow cot, staring at his own empty cupped hands as if something precious were in them. His eyes reflect a red glow that has no source. Moonlight through a barred window, a cracked green wall.

Inside the diner from the location plate, late at night. In the corner booth sits John Dee, the man from the character sheet, in his tan raincoat, the glowing red ruby on the table before him, hands folded, smiling politely at the camera. At the counter the customers and the waitress sit unnaturally still.

shots.motion: The ruby pulses red; the fluorescent lights flicker; one by one the customers at the counter slowly turn their heads toward the camera with blank fixed smiles; Dee tilts his head and smiles wider. Slow push-in toward the booth.

keyframe.prompt: Close on John Dee, the man from the character sheet, standing at the diner table, the red ruby raised high in both hands above his head, face twisted in triumph, about to smash it down on the table. Red light from the stone fills the frame.

shots.motion: Dee smashes the ruby down on the table; it shatters in a blinding burst of red light; the light turns silver and streams in a spiral toward the camera; Dee staggers back and collapses to the floor, small and broken. Hand-held shake on the impact.

keyframe.prompt: The park in the morning from the location plate. Death, the young woman from the character sheet, sits on the green bench throwing breadcrumbs to the pigeons. Beside her on the bench, at the edge of the frame, a tall woman with very long straight black hair in a long black gown, seen only from behind, her face never visible, sitting with her head bowed. Low golden sunlight, mist lifting.

shots.motion: Death tosses a handful of breadcrumbs and the pigeons flutter up around her; she laughs, then turns to the woman beside her with a warm teasing smile and nudges her with her shoulder. Gentle hand-held drift.

keyframe.prompt: A small, dim, tidy apartment at dusk: an old man in a cardigan sits in a worn armchair beside a window, a violin resting on the table next to him. Death, the young woman from the character sheet, kneels beside the chair holding his hand, smiling up at him with great tenderness. Warm lamplight.

shots.motion: The old man smiles back at her; a translucent, younger version of him rises out of his body and stands, holding her hand, while his body stays peaceful in the chair; together they turn toward the window light. Static camera, slight sway.

keyframe.prompt: The garden of forking paths from the location plate at grey twilight. In the foreground, a tall woman with very long straight black hair in a long black gown, seen only from behind, her face never visible, walks along a misty gravel path between tall clipped hedges. Far ahead, small at the end of the path, Destiny from the character sheet stands waiting in his hooded robe, his great chained book open in his arms.

shots.motion: The woman walks slowly forward along the path; behind her, the hedges and paths silently slide and rearrange themselves into new forks; mist drifts; far ahead, the hooded figure turns a page. Slow follow from behind.

keyframe.prompt: Medium close-up of Destiny, the man from the character sheet, standing in his misty garden of forking paths, hood up, blind pale eyes looking just past the camera, his great chained book open in his arms, one long finger resting on a line of writing. Grey twilight, soft and solemn.

The convocation hall from the location plate, seen from the empty chair at the near end of the long black table, as if the viewer has just sat down. Around the table, each in their own light from above: at the far end Destiny (hooded, book open); along the left Death (young woman in black with an ankh) and Desire (androgynous, cream suit, red rose); along the right Despair (short grey woman) and Delirium (teenage girl with multicoloured hair, small fish in the air). One chair at the table stands empty and dark. Each person matches their character sheet exactly. A single candle on the table.

shots.motion: One by one the family turn their heads to look at the camera: Death smiles warmly, Desire smirks, Despair lowers her eyes, Delirium waves with both hands while her little fish swim around her head; Destiny turns a page. Candle flickers. Static camera, slight sway.

keyframe.prompt: Close-up at the black table of the convocation hall: Desire, the person from the character sheet, lounges back in its chair under a deep red light, one arm over the chair back, smiling straight at the camera with tawny gold eyes. A rose petal hangs in the air.

Close-up at the black table of the convocation hall: Despair, the woman from the character sheet, sits hunched in her chair under a dull grey-green light, looking up at the camera through her lashes, sad and gentle, her ringed hand on the table.

Close-up at the black table of the convocation hall: Delirium, the girl from the character sheet, kneels up on her chair under a shifting rainbow light, leaning toward the camera with a delighted, wandering smile, three small bright fish swimming in the air around her head. Photoreal, a real actress.

Close-up at the black table of the convocation hall: Death, the young woman from the character sheet, sits under a warm white light, chin on her hand, smiling warmly at the camera like a big sister at a dull family dinner.

Tight close-up at the black table of the convocation hall: Desire, the person from the character sheet, leaning forward toward the camera under deep red light, chin resting on laced fingers, a slow, knowing, cruel smile, tawny gold eyes. Red rose petals hang in the air.

shots.motion: Desire leans in a little closer and its smile widens slowly; it tilts its head; red rose petals drift past and turn in the air; the red light pulses faintly. Slow push-in.

keyframe.prompt: At the open, colossal gates of an empty Hell from the location plate, grey ash falling: Lucifer, the man from the character sheet, stands alone in his black robe with his great white wings spread wide behind him, eyes closed, face calm and tired, a huge old iron key hanging from one hand.

shots.motion: Lucifer's great wings loosen and come apart into a slow storm of white and black feathers that rise into the dark sky; he lowers his head, lighter, and a faint smile crosses his face; ash and feathers drift past the camera. Slow push-in.

keyframe.prompt: The great hall from the location plate, the banquet laid, seen from the high seat at the head of the hall looking down its length. The guests have arrived and stand by the long tables: on the left the Norse delegation (one-eyed Odin with ravens, red-bearded Thor, braided copper-haired Loki in a rust leather coat); in the centre the two Faerie envoys (golden-curled Cluracan in peacock silk, small silver-haired Nuala); on the right the two white-robed winged angels; and at the far end a tall column of living darkness full of eyes wearing an iron crown (Azazel). Every figure matches their character sheet.

shots.motion: The guests turn one by one toward the camera and bow or raise a goblet; Odin's ravens shift their wings; candle flames lean toward the camera; the angels' wings stir; the darkness of Azazel ripples. Slow push-in down the hall.

keyframe.prompt: Medium shot at the banquet table in the great hall: Odin, Thor and Loki from the character sheet, Odin seated in the centre with his spear and ravens, looking at the camera with his one hard eye; Thor laughing with a goblet; Loki leaning in, smiling slyly. Torchlight.

Medium shot at the banquet table in the great hall: Azazel from the character sheet, a tall column of living darkness full of eyes and mouths beneath an iron crown, one long grey hand resting a small glass jar on the table; inside the jar a tiny bright point of light flickers. Candles gutter away from it.

Medium shot at the banquet table in the great hall: Cluracan from the character sheet raising his goblet toward the camera with a dazzling smile; beside him his sister Nuala, small and shy, looking up at the camera with hope. Pale moths circle Nuala. Warm candlelight.

Medium shot in the great hall: the two angels from the character sheet, Remiel and Duma, standing apart from the feast, white wings folded, hands clasped, looking at the camera with calm, grave patience. Starlight from the open ceiling falls on them.

The same woman as in the first image, Nada, a young African queen of an ancient city, now free of the ice: she stands in the bare white room from the second image, in her white linen gown and gold collar, braided hair threaded with gold, facing the camera, dignified, wary, her eyes wet. Soft white light all around her; a few grains of golden sand falling.

shots.motion: Nada closes her eyes and smiles through tears; her body slowly turns to warm golden light that drifts upward like rising sand until only light remains in the white room. Very slow push-in.

keyframe.prompt: Medium close-up in the endless library from the location plate: Lucienne, the woman from the character sheet, holds out toward the camera a heavy cream envelope sealed with dark red wax stamped with the sign of an open book. Her lantern beside her on the reading table. Her expression: respectful, worried. Warm lantern light, dust in the air.

The 1988 cellar from the location plate at grey dawn, the glass sphere shattered behind. Paul McGuire, the man from the first character sheet, now in his late seventies, kneels in the dust beside an old wheelchair, one hand on the arm of the chair where Alex Burgess, the old man from the second character sheet, sits rigid with open, staring, sleepless eyes. Paul looks up at the camera, pleading, tears on his face. Cold dawn light through the high window, dust in the air.

Richard Madoc, the man from the character sheet, in his book-lined London study at night, 1990, seated at a big desk with a typewriter and a stack of his own hardback novels, a literary prize statuette on the shelf behind him, lit by a green banker's lamp.
